sources.title: Australian Tax Calculators 1.2.0 release
sources.fact: Primary-source discovery only; no human-reviewed current-law fact is recorded.
sources.limitations: An agent checked the Windows archive against the release's SHA256SUMS, downloaded again from the release, and against its attestation on 24 November 2026; its executable printed `australian-tax-calculators 1.2.0` and its periods command listed 2018-19 to 2026-27 for cgt_cost_base_adjustments. Human review pending.

sources.title: Australian Tax Calculators 1.2.0 source at its tagged commit
sources.fact: Primary-source discovery only; no human-reviewed current-law fact is recorded.
sources.limitations: An agent read the worksheet catalogue the 1.2.0 executable returns for `cgt-cost-base-adjustments` on 24 November 2026: its scope statement, inputs, periods and refusals. It applies an AMIT cost base net amount it is given and does not work out the trustee's estimate. Human review pending.

sources.title: ATO: Attribution managed investment trust tax return instructions 2026
sources.fact: Primary-source discovery only; no human-reviewed current-law fact is recorded.
sources.limitations: PDF of the 2026 instructions (published 31 May 2026), read by an agent on 24 November 2026: lodging the return is taken to make the irrevocable AMIT choice; at least one AMIT tax schedule; lodgment by 31 October for a 30 June year; the withholding MIT question, deemed payment labels, trustee liability labels, statement of attribution codes 138 to 140 and the AMIT tax schedule's unders, overs and determined trust component labels. Human review pending.

sources.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 1) Act 2026
sources.fact: Primary-source discovery only; no human-reviewed current-law fact is recorded.
sources.limitations: No. 49, 2026, assented to 26 June 2026, read by an agent on 24 November 2026: Schedule 1 changes capital gains and the CGT discount, with Part 4 applying them from the income year that includes 1 July 2027; its items 80 and 81 amend ss 12-405 and 12A-110 in Schedule 1 to the TAA 1953. It makes no amendment to Divisions 275 or 276 of the ITAA 1997. Human source approval remains pending.
